newsitem.title: USA: Avon to buy Discovery Toys.
newsitem.headline: Avon to buy Discovery Toys.

text.p: Avon Products Inc Wednesday said it definitively agreed to acquire Discovery Toys Inc, a direct seller of educational toys, games, books, and software.
Although terms were not disclosed, Avon said that the acquisition is not a significant financial transaction. The acquisition is expected to be completed within the next several weeks.

Discovery Toys, based in Livermore, Calif., sells its exclusive children's educational products through about 30,000 independent educational consultants in the U.S. The company generated revenues of about $80 million, including sales commissions, in 1996.
Following the acquisition, Discovery Toys will operate as a separate unit of Avon and Lane Nemeth will remain as chief executive officer.
Avon said that the transaction reflects its interest in complementing its existing operations in the direct selling industry to enable it to further penetrate new product and customer segments.
